# arin Provider

Manage ARIN registration and routing resources. Currently supports organization lookup through Reg-RWS. Configure the API key through `ARIN_API_KEY` when possible.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    arin = {
      source = "as19814/arin"
    }
  }
}

# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
provider "arin" {
  base_url        = "https://reg.ote.arin.net"
  timeout_seconds = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) ARIN API key. Defaults to `ARIN_API_KEY`. Your account must have authority over the requested records.
- `base_url` (String) API origin. Defaults to `ARIN_BASE_URL`, then `https://reg.arin.net`. Use `https://reg.ote.arin.net` for OT&E. HTTPS is required except for loopback test servers.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) HTTP request timeout in seconds, from 1 to 300. Defaults to 30.
